definition: A neurological condition resulting from damage to or dysfunction of the cerebellum that manifests clinically as movement incoordination, motor variability, gait impairment, and slurred speech.

source.title: Evaluation of cerebellar ataxic patients
source.quote: Cerebellar ataxia results from damage to the cerebellum and presents as movement incoordination and variability, gait impairment, and slurred speech.
